metadata.title: Study Pods
metadata.description: Quiet, class-based study pods where classmates can see each other's progress.

setup.heading: Getting started
setup.allDone: You're all set. From here, just keep logging your progress.

join.title: Join a class
join.body: Use the link or QR code from your class.

pod.title: Join a pod
pod.body: Invite classmates, or accept an invitation you've received.

target.title: Set your first target
target.body: Pick a report length or study hours from a template.

login.title: Log in to Study Pods
login.intro: No password needed. We'll email a 6-digit login code and a login link to your university address.
login.codeBody: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. You can log in by opening the link in the email, or by entering the code here.

confirm.title: Log in to Study Pods
confirm.body: Press the button to log in on this browser. It works on a phone or a computer.
confirm.ignore: If you didn't ask to log in, just close this page. Nothing will happen.
confirm.expiredBody: It expired after 1 hour, or you already logged in with the code or the button.
confirm.expiredHint: If you're already logged in, "Open Home" takes you straight in.

pods.joinToSee: Join this class to see pods and start your own.
pods.notInPod: Start a pod and invite classmates, or wait for an invitation. A pod has up to 6 people.
pods.notInPodTitle: You're not in a pod yet

progress.subtitle: Targets & progress
progress.notInPod: You're not in a pod yet.
progress.noRecentProgress: Nothing logged in the last 7 days.
progress.projection: At {pace} a day over the last 7 days, you'd finish around {finish}.
progress.projectionWithDeadline: At {pace} a day over the last 7 days, you'd finish around {finish}. The deadline is {deadline}.

targetForm.templatesHint: A template fills in the fields below. You can change anything afterwards.

logForm.needTarget: Create a target above before you log progress.

nudges.heading: Nudges
nudges.messagePlaceholder: e.g. How's it going? Anything you're stuck on?

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
errors.signedOut: You need to be signed in. Please log in again.
errors.notAllowed: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.authFailed: We couldn't sign you in. Please try again.
errors.emailDomain: Only @andrew.ac.jp email addresses can be used. Please enter your university email.
errors.emailInvalid: That doesn't look like a valid email address.
errors.rateLimited: Too many tries in a short time. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.classFieldsRequired: Please fill in the class name, university and term.
errors.requestPending: You've already asked to join this pod.
errors.targetAmountPositive: The target amount needs to be a number above 0.
errors.tooLong: Please keep it to 280 characters or fewer.
errors.notOwnTarget: You can only log progress on your own targets.
errors.nudgeLimit: You can nudge the same person up to 3 times in 24 hours. Please give it a little while.
errors.nudgeFailed: Couldn't send that nudge. Check that you're still in the same pod.
errors.codeInvalid: That code is wrong or has expired. Check the code in your email, or send a new one.
errors.resendTooSoon: Please wait a little before resending the code.
errors.displayNameTooLong: Please keep your display name to 20 characters or fewer.
errors.displayNameInvalid: Display names can't contain line breaks or other special characters.
errors.alreadyInPod: You're already in a pod in this class. You can be in one pod per class.
errors.inviteeInPod: This classmate is already in another pod in this class.
errors.alreadyPodmate: This classmate is already in this pod.
errors.joinCodeInvalid: This link doesn't work. Please check the link again.

welcome.title: Choose the name your pod will see
welcome.body: Classmates in your classes and pods will see this name. Right now they see part of your email address: “{current}”.
welcome.label: Display name
welcome.hint: A nickname is fine. You can change it later in Settings.
welcome.previewHeading: How your pod will see you

nudgesPage.title: Nudges
nudgesPage.emptyBody: When a podmate nudges you, it shows up here. If someone in your pod hasn't logged anything for a while, you can nudge them too.
nudgesPage.rule: You can nudge the same person up to 3 times in 24 hours.

empty.noClasses: There are no classes to join yet.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The link may be out of date, or the page may have been removed.

join.body: If you join, people in this class will see your display name. Only your podmates can see your progress.
join.invalidBody: The link may be old, or the code may be wrong. Please check the link with your teacher or a classmate.

invite.heading: Invite to this class
invite.body: Anyone who gets this link or QR code can join this class directly.
invite.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. The link is selected, so you can copy it yourself.
invite.qrHint: Ready to use on slides or a notice board
invite.anyMemberCanShare: Anyone in this class can share this link.
